examples: The mechanic gave the car a thorough inspection before the long road trip.
مکانیک قبل از سفر طولانی، ماشین را به‌طور کامل و دقیق بازرسی کرد.
She did a thorough review of the contract before signing it.
او قبل از امضای قرارداد، بررسی دقیقی از آن انجام داد.
The detective's thorough investigation eventually revealed the truth behind the robbery.
تحقیق دقیق کارآگاه سرانجام حقیقت پشت آن دزدی را فاش کرد.
miniContext: Thorough describes work done carefully and completely, leaving nothing important overlooked. A thorough cleaning reaches every corner of a room, and a thorough doctor checks every possible symptom before making a diagnosis. The word praises attention to detail and completeness, as opposed to a quick or careless job.

examples: She is undoubtedly the most talented musician in the orchestra.
او بدون شک با استعدادترین نوازنده در ارکستر است.
The new policy will undoubtedly cause some confusion among employees at first.
سیاست جدید بدون شک در ابتدا باعث سردرگمی برخی کارمندان خواهد شد.
Undoubtedly, climate change is affecting weather patterns around the world.
بدون شک، تغییرات آب‌وهوایی بر الگوهای جوی در سراسر جهان تأثیر می‌گذارد.
miniContext: Undoubtedly means certainly or without any doubt, used to emphasize that a statement is clearly true. A critic might say a film is undoubtedly the director's best work, or a teacher might admit a student is undoubtedly gifted despite poor grades. The word adds strong confidence to whatever claim follows it.

examples: The teacher used a creative approach to make grammar lessons more interesting.
معلم از یک رویکرد خلاقانه برای جذاب‌تر کردن درس‌های گرامر استفاده کرد.
Doctors are exploring a new approach to treating chronic pain.
پزشکان رویکردی جدید برای درمان درد مزمن را بررسی می‌کنند.
As winter began to approach, the birds started flying south.
همان‌طور که زمستان شروع به نزدیک شدن کرد، پرندگان شروع به پرواز به سوی جنوب کردند.
miniContext: An approach is a particular way of doing something or dealing with a problem, often one chosen deliberately after considering alternatives. Teachers use different approaches for different learning styles, and companies take a cautious approach when entering a new market. As a verb, approach also means to come closer to something in space or time, as when a storm approaches the coast.

examples: The new coffee shop quickly became popular with students from the nearby university.
کافی‌شاپ جدید به‌سرعت در میان دانشجویان دانشگاه نزدیک محبوب شد.
This song was especially popular during the summer, playing constantly on the radio.
این آهنگ به‌خصوص در تابستان محبوب بود و دائماً از رادیو پخش می‌شد.
The mayor remained popular among voters despite several controversial decisions.
شهردار با وجود چندین تصمیم بحث‌برانگیز، همچنان در میان رأی‌دهندگان محبوب ماند.
miniContext: Popular describes something or someone liked, enjoyed, or supported by a large number of people. A popular restaurant is always crowded, a popular opinion is shared by the majority, and a popular singer fills stadiums with fans. The word measures widespread appeal rather than personal or expert approval.

examples: He began to neglect his studies after joining the soccer team.
او بعد از پیوستن به تیم فوتبال، شروع کرد به تحصیلاتش بی‌توجهی کند.
The landlord was fined for neglecting repairs that the tenants had requested for months.
صاحب‌خانه به دلیل غفلت از تعمیراتی که مستأجرها ماه‌ها درخواست کرده بودند جریمه شد.
Please don't neglect your health while you're busy preparing for exams.
لطفاً در حین آمادگی برای امتحانات، به سلامتی‌ات بی‌توجهی نکن.
miniContext: To neglect something means to fail to give it the care or attention it needs, often causing harm over time. Parents who neglect a child's basic needs can face legal consequences, and a gardener who neglects watering will lose the plants eventually. The word implies a failure of responsibility, whether intentional or simply the result of being distracted by other things.

examples: Every employee is required to attend the safety training session next week.
هر کارمندی موظف است در جلسه آموزش ایمنی هفته آینده شرکت کند.
The company rewarded its best employee with a bonus and an extra vacation day.
شرکت بهترین کارمندش را با پاداش و یک روز تعطیلی اضافه تشویق کرد.
As a new employee, she spent her first week shadowing more experienced staff.
او به‌عنوان کارمند جدید، هفته اول خود را صرف همراهی با کارکنان باتجربه‌تر کرد.
miniContext: An employee is a person who works for a company or organization in exchange for pay, following the direction of an employer. Large corporations may have thousands of employees across different departments, while a small shop might have only one or two. The word distinguishes someone hired to do a job from the business owner or employer who pays them.

examples: The factory recalled thousands of cars because of a defect in the brake system.
کارخانه هزاران خودرو را به دلیل نقصی در سیستم ترمز فراخوانی کرد.
Doctors detected a small heart defect in the newborn during a routine checkup.
پزشکان در یک معاینه معمول، نقص کوچکی در قلب نوزاد تشخیص دادند.
The jeweler noticed a tiny defect in the diamond that lowered its value.
جواهرساز نقص کوچکی در الماس متوجه شد که ارزش آن را کاهش داد.
miniContext: A defect is a flaw or imperfection in something, often one that affects its function, appearance, or value. Manufacturers try to catch a defect before a product reaches customers, and a birth defect can affect how an organ develops. The word suggests something is not quite right, falling short of how it was supposed to be made or to work.

examples: He tried to deceive his business partner by hiding the company's true losses.
او سعی کرد شریک تجاری‌اش را با پنهان کردن ضررهای واقعی شرکت فریب دهد.
Advertisers sometimes use misleading images to deceive customers about a product's size.
تبلیغ‌کنندگان گاهی از تصاویر گمراه‌کننده برای فریب دادن مشتریان درباره اندازه محصول استفاده می‌کنند.
She felt betrayed when she discovered how long he had been deceiving her.
او وقتی فهمید چه مدت او را فریب داده بود، احساس خیانت کرد.
miniContext: To deceive someone means to make them believe something false, usually in order to gain an advantage or avoid blame. A con artist deceives victims to steal their money, and a cheating spouse deceives their partner to hide the truth. The word always implies a deliberate, often harmful, attempt to mislead rather than an innocent mistake.

examples: The smoke alarm is designed to detect fire within seconds.
آلارم دود طراحی شده تا آتش را در عرض چند ثانیه تشخیص دهد.
Doctors used an X-ray to detect the fracture in his wrist.
پزشکان از اشعه ایکس برای تشخیص شکستگی در مچ دستش استفاده کردند.
She could detect a slight change in her friend's tone during the phone call.
او توانست تغییر کوچکی در لحن دوستش در طول تماس تلفنی تشخیص دهد.
miniContext: To detect something means to discover or notice it, often something subtle, hidden, or not immediately obvious. Sensors detect motion, doctors detect illness through tests, and a sharp listener can detect sarcasm in someone's voice. The word implies careful observation or specialized tools that reveal something that might otherwise be missed.

examples: The lawyer spent the afternoon reviewing documents with her client.
وکیل بعدازظهر را صرف بررسی اسناد با مشتری‌اش کرد.
Every client at the salon receives a complimentary cup of tea while waiting.
هر مشتری در آن سالن در حین انتظار یک فنجان چای رایگان دریافت می‌کند.
The consulting firm lost an important client after missing the project deadline.
شرکت مشاوره‌ای بعد از از دست دادن مهلت پروژه، یک مشتری مهم را از دست داد.
miniContext: A client is a person or organization that receives professional services from someone such as a lawyer, consultant, designer, or financial advisor, usually in exchange for payment. Unlike a customer who buys a product in a store, a client typically has an ongoing or personal relationship with the professional helping them. Law firms, accounting offices, and marketing agencies all depend on building trust with their clients.

examples: The textbook offers a comprehensive overview of world history from ancient times to today.
کتاب درسی مروری جامع بر تاریخ جهان از دوران باستان تا امروز ارائه می‌دهد.
Her comprehensive research covered every major aspect of the disease.
تحقیق جامع او تمام جنبه‌های اصلی بیماری را پوشش داد.
The company offers a comprehensive insurance plan that includes dental and vision coverage.
شرکت یک طرح بیمه جامع ارائه می‌دهد که پوشش دندان‌پزشکی و بینایی را نیز شامل می‌شود.
miniContext: Comprehensive describes something that covers all or nearly all relevant parts of a subject, leaving little or nothing out. A comprehensive exam tests knowledge across an entire course, and a comprehensive plan considers every possible scenario before moving forward. The word signals thoroughness in scope, complementing 'thorough,' which signals care in execution.

examples: The accountant was arrested for using fake invoices to defraud the company.
حسابدار به دلیل استفاده از فاکتورهای جعلی برای کلاهبرداری از شرکت بازداشت شد.
Scammers often pose as bank officials to defraud elderly customers over the phone.
کلاهبرداران اغلب خود را کارمند بانک جا می‌زنند تا از طریق تلفن از مشتریان مسن کلاهبرداری کنند.
The investigation revealed that the manager had defrauded investors out of millions of dollars.
تحقیقات نشان داد که مدیر میلیون‌ها دلار از سرمایه‌گذاران کلاهبرداری کرده بود.
miniContext: To defraud someone means to deliberately deceive them in order to take their money or property illegally. A fraudster might defraud a company through fake billing, or defraud an elderly person through a phone scam pretending to be a relative in trouble. The word is stronger and more legal in tone than simple lying, specifically pointing to financial deception with criminal consequences.
